user.title: Choose Connection Type
user.description: Select how you want to connect to your S7 PLC.

rack_slot.title: Connect to S7 PLC (Rack/Slot)
rack_slot.description: Enter your S7 PLC connection details using Rack and Slot. A connection test will run before saving.

data_description.name: A friendly name for the PLC (used in entity names).
data_description.host: IP or hostname of the PLC.
data_description.pys7_connection_type: S7 connection type (PG – programming, OP – operator panel, S7 Basic – basic connection).
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the PLC, in seconds. Use decimal values for millisecond precision.
data_description.operation_timeout: Maximum duration for a single read/write cycle before retrying.
data_description.max_retries: How many times to retry a failed PLC operation before giving up.
data_description.retry_backoff_initial: Delay before the first retry attempt.
data_description.optimize_read: Enable optimized batch reads to improve performance. If you experience read errors, disable this option.
data_description.enable_write_batching: Automatically group writes together. When multiple entities update simultaneously, writes are combined into a single PLC request (50ms window). Improves performance for scenes and bulk operations.
data_description.enable_metrics: Enable performance metrics. Collects and reports performance data for monitoring and optimization.

common.title: S7 PLC configuration

area.label: Area
area.description: Home Assistant area to assign this entity to.

name.label: Name
name.description: Optional descriptive name for this entity.

scan_interval.label: Scan interval (s)
scan_interval.description: Polling frequency specific to this entity in seconds. Use decimal values for millisecond precision. If omitted, the PLC default scan interval is used.

availability_mode.label: Availability policy
availability_mode.description: Choose when Home Assistant considers this entity available.

descriptions.connection: The entity follows the PLC connection and the availability of its required data.
descriptions.always: The entity remains available using its last known state, but commands still fail while the PLC is disconnected.
descriptions.bit: The entity is available only while the PLC is connected and the configured bit is true.

availability_address.label: Availability BIT address
availability_address.description: BIT address that must be true while the PLC is connected.

command_behavior.title: Command behavior
command_behavior.description: How Home Assistant controls the PLC output

options.title: Options
options.description: Settings for the selected behavior and Control mode

address.label: Address
address.description: PLC address to read (e.g., DB1000,D0, MW10, DB1,W2).

device_class.label: Device class
device_class.description: Home Assistant device class to refine the UI/behavior (e.g., battery, power).

unit_of_measurement.label: Unit of measurement
unit_of_measurement.description: Custom unit of measurement (e.g., °C, RPM, bar). Leave blank to use the default unit based on device class.

state_class.label: State class
state_class.description: State class for statistics: 'measurement' for instantaneous values, 'total' for cumulative values that can decrease, 'total_increasing' for counters (e.g., energy, water consumption). Leave blank for automatic.

real_precision.label: REAL decimal precision
real_precision.description: Number of decimal places for REAL values. Leave blank to use the default (1).

address.label: Address
address.description: PLC boolean address (e.g., I0.0, Q1.3, DB10,X0.1).

device_class.label: Device class
device_class.description: Home Assistant device class to refine the UI/behavior (e.g., door, window, power).

invert_state.label: Invert state
invert_state.description: Invert the state: PLC True becomes Off, PLC False becomes On. Useful for NC (Normally Closed) contacts.

state_address.label: State address
state_address.description: PLC address to read the current state (e.g., Q0.0, DB20,X0.0).

command_address.label: Command address
command_address.description: PLC address to write commands (optional). If omitted, only state will be read.

pulse_duration.label: Pulse duration (s)
pulse_duration.description: Duration of the pulse in seconds. Minimum: 0.1s, Maximum: 60s.

open_command_address.label: Open command address
open_command_address.description: PLC address to trigger opening (e.g., Q0.0, DB1,X0.0).
open_command_address.description_toggle: PLC address of the single pulse command used for opening, stopping and closing the cover.

close_command_address.label: Close command address
close_command_address.description: PLC address to trigger closing (e.g., Q0.1, DB1,X0.1).

cover_status_address.label: Cover status address
cover_status_address.description: PLC address containing the cover status, matched against the value(s) configured below. Depending on the selected position and movement feedback sources, it can supply the settled open/closed position, the movement state, or both.

cover_status_open_values.label: Open status value(s)
cover_status_open_values.description: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is fully open, read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 1 or 2,3). When matched, the cover's closed state is determined by this, taking priority over the end-stop based state. Leave empty to skip this status.

cover_status_closed_values.label: Closed status value(s)
cover_status_closed_values.description: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is fully closed, read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas. When matched, the cover's closed state is determined by this, taking priority over the end-stop based state. Leave empty to skip this status.

cover_status_opening_values.label: Opening status value(s)
cover_status_opening_values.description: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is opening, read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 1 or 2,3). Leave empty to skip this status.

cover_status_closing_values.label: Closing status value(s)
cover_status_closing_values.description: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is closing, read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status.

cover_status_stopped_values.label: Stopped status value(s)
cover_status_stopped_values.description: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is stopped (not moving), read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status.

opening_state_address.label: Fully-open end stop
opening_state_address.description: PLC address that indicates the cover is opened.

closing_state_address.label: Fully-closed end stop
closing_state_address.description: PLC address that indicates the cover is closed.

cover_opening_address.label: Opening status address
cover_opening_address.description: Boolean PLC address that indicates the cover is currently opening. Independent of the opened/closed end-stop addresses above.

cover_closing_address.label: Closing status address
cover_closing_address.description: Boolean PLC address that indicates the cover is currently closing. Independent of the opened/closed end-stop addresses above.

cover_stopped_address.label: Stopped status address
cover_stopped_address.description: Boolean PLC address that indicates the cover is stopped (not moving).

position_state_address.label: Position state address
position_state_address.description: PLC address to read the current position value (0-100, e.g., DB1,B0, DB2,W4).

position_command_address.label: Position command address
position_command_address.description: PLC address to write position commands (0-100). If omitted, the state address is used.

stop_command_address.label: Stop command address
stop_command_address.description: PLC boolean address to pulse when stop is pressed. If omitted, stop writes the current position back.

stop_pulse_duration.label: Stop pulse duration (s)
stop_pulse_duration.description: Duration in seconds for the stop pulse (supports decimals, e.g., 0.5 for 500ms).

toggle_pulse_duration.label: Single-button pulse duration (s)
toggle_pulse_duration.description: Duration in seconds for the single relay pulse in single-button mode (supports decimals, e.g., 0.5 for 500ms).

tilt_state_address.label: Tilt state address
tilt_state_address.description: Optional PLC address to read the current tilt position (0-100). Enables tilt control (open/close/set/stop tilt) for this cover.

tilt_command_address.label: Tilt command address
tilt_command_address.description: PLC address to write tilt position commands (optional). If omitted, the tilt state address is used.

invert_tilt.label: Invert tilt
invert_tilt.description: Invert the tilt scale (0 becomes 100 and vice versa), for actuators wired the opposite way.

operate_time.label: Operate time (s)
operate_time.description: Seconds to keep the command active before resetting the outputs and clearing the movement state.

use_state_topics.label: Use state topics for position
use_state_topics.description: Enable to use state feedback addresses for determining cover position. When disabled, position is inferred from operate time.

invert_position.label: Invert position (0=open, 100=closed)
invert_position.description: Enable if your PLC uses 0 for fully open and 100 for fully closed (reverses the normal logic).

device_class.label: Device class
device_class.description: Home Assistant device class to refine the UI/behavior (e.g., shutter, blind, garage).

cover_control_mode.label: Control type
cover_control_mode.description: Choose how the PLC controls the cover.

descriptions.traditional: Two discrete open and close commands.

cover_position_feedback.label: Position feedback
cover_position_feedback.description: Choose how terminal position is determined.

descriptions.position: Use the reported position value directly - no separate feedback needed.
descriptions.opening: Read only the fully-open limit switch.
descriptions.closing: Read only the fully-closed limit switch.
descriptions.both: Read both fully-open and fully-closed limit switches.
descriptions.status: Use one PLC word mapped to open, closed, opening, closing, and stopped.

cover_movement_feedback.label: Movement feedback
cover_movement_feedback.description: Choose how current movement is reported.

descriptions.none: Use internal estimation, or position only.
descriptions.bits: Read separate opening, closing, and stopped bits.

cover_stop_enabled.label: Stop command
cover_stop_enabled.description: Enable a dedicated PLC stop command.

control.title: Control type
control.description: Select the control model before entering PLC addresses.

position_feedback.title: Position feedback
position_feedback.description: Choose timed estimation, one or both limit switches, or a mapped PLC status word.

movement_feedback.title: Movement feedback
movement_feedback.description: Keep movement indication independent from terminal position.

stop.title: Stop
stop.description: Optionally configure a dedicated stop command for position covers.

tilt.title: Tilt
tilt.description: Optional tilt control for position covers.

state_address.label: State address (on/off)
state_address.description: PLC boolean address to read the on/off state (e.g., DB1,X0.0).

command_address.label: Command address (on/off)
command_address.description: PLC boolean address to write on/off commands (optional). If omitted, the state address is used.

brightness_state_address.label: Brightness state address
brightness_state_address.description: PLC numeric address to read the brightness level (e.g., DB1,B2). Leave blank for on/off only.

brightness_command_address.label: Brightness command address
brightness_command_address.description: PLC numeric address to write brightness commands (optional). If omitted, the brightness state address is used.

pulse_duration.label: Pulse duration (s)
pulse_duration.description: Duration of the pulse in seconds (0.1-60s, supports decimals). Default: 0.5s.

address.label: Address
address.description: PLC boolean address to pulse (e.g., Q0.0, DB1,X0.1).

button_pulse.label: Pulse duration
button_pulse.description: Duration of the pulse in seconds.

address.label: State address
address.description: PLC address to read the numeric value (e.g., DB1,D0, DB2,W4).

command_address.label: Command address
command_address.description: PLC address to write values (optional). If omitted, the state address is used.

device_class.label: Device class
device_class.description: Device class for the number entity (e.g., temperature, voltage, power).

unit_of_measurement.label: Unit of measurement
unit_of_measurement.description: Custom unit of measurement (e.g., °C, V, kW). Leave blank if not needed.

min_value.label: Minimum limit
min_value.description: Minimum value selectable in Home Assistant. It neither modifies nor converts the value read from the PLC.

max_value.label: Maximum limit
max_value.description: Maximum value selectable in Home Assistant. It neither modifies nor converts the value read from the PLC.

step.label: Step
step.description: Optional increment used when adjusting the value in the UI.

real_precision.label: REAL decimal precision
real_precision.description: Number of decimal places for REAL values. Leave blank to use the default (1).

address.label: State address
address.description: PLC address holding the current option value (BYTE, WORD, DWORD, SINT, USINT, INT, DINT, or TIME). TIME values are seconds.

command_address.label: Command address
command_address.description: PLC address to write the selected value (optional). If omitted, the state address is used.

options_map.label: Options map
options_map.description: Each PLC value maps to the option shown in Home Assistant. TIME values are expressed in seconds. In YAML this is stored as 'value:label' pairs separated by ';'.

address.label: State address
address.description: PLC STRING or WSTRING address to read (e.g., DB1,S0.254, DB2,WS0.128).

command_address.label: Command address
command_address.description: PLC address to write text values (optional). If omitted, the state address is used.

pattern.label: Pattern (regex)
pattern.description: Optional regex pattern to validate the text input.

control_mode.label: Control type
control_mode.description: Home Assistant regulates temperature and controls PLC heating/cooling outputs.

descriptions.direct: Home Assistant regulates temperature and controls PLC heating/cooling outputs.
descriptions.setpoint: The PLC regulates temperature while Home Assistant reads and writes its setpoint.

current_temperature_address.label: Current temperature address
current_temperature_address.description: PLC address to read current temperature (e.g., DB1,REAL0, DB2,INT4).

target_temperature_address.label: Target temperature address
target_temperature_address.description: PLC address to write and read target temperature setpoint (e.g., DB1,REAL4, DB2,INT8).

heating_output_address.label: Heating output address
heating_output_address.description: PLC address to control heating output (e.g., Q0.0, DB1,X0.0). Optional if only cooling is used.

cooling_output_address.label: Cooling output address
cooling_output_address.description: PLC address to control cooling output (e.g., Q0.1, DB1,X0.1). Optional if only heating is used.

heating_action_address.label: Heating action address
heating_action_address.description: Optional PLC address to read heating action state. If not specified, action is inferred from mode.

cooling_action_address.label: Cooling action address
cooling_action_address.description: Optional PLC address to read cooling action state. If not specified, action is inferred from mode.

preset_mode_address.label: HVAC mode address
preset_mode_address.description: Optional PLC address to write the HVAC mode, using the value configured below for each mode. Write-only by default; enable HVAC mode feedback to also read it back.

preset_mode_bidirectional.label: HVAC mode readback
preset_mode_bidirectional.description: Keep the last HVAC mode commanded by Home Assistant.

descriptions.false: Keep the last HVAC mode commanded by Home Assistant.
descriptions.true: Read back the selected HVAC mode from the mode address; this is not heating/cooling operating status.

on_off_address.label: On/off address
on_off_address.description: Optional boolean PLC address to switch this thermostat on/off, for devices with no native OFF mode of their own (e.g. a heater/cooler turned on/off by a separate output). Writes False/0 when the target mode is set to OFF, and True/1 for any other mode. Leave blank to rely on the standard OFF behavior instead. Also read back from the PLC to reflect the actual on/off state (bidirectional).

preset_mode_off_value.label: Off mode value
preset_mode_off_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to OFF (e.g. 0). Leave empty to hide this mode from the thermostat's mode list. If on_off_address is configured, this is ignored for OFF: the mode stays available and is switched via that address instead.

preset_mode_heat_value.label: Heat mode value
preset_mode_heat_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to HEAT (e.g. 1). Leave empty to hide this mode from the thermostat's mode list.

preset_mode_cool_value.label: Cool mode value
preset_mode_cool_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to COOL (e.g. 2). Leave empty to hide this mode from the thermostat's mode list.

preset_mode_heat_cool_value.label: Heat/Cool (auto) mode value
preset_mode_heat_cool_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to HEAT/COOL (auto) (e.g. 3). Leave empty to hide this mode from the thermostat's mode list.

preset_mode_auto_value.label: Auto mode value
preset_mode_auto_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to AUTO (legacy alias for automatic heat/cool switching, similar to Heat/Cool). Disabled (left empty) by default.

preset_mode_dry_value.label: Dry mode value
preset_mode_dry_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to DRY (dehumidify only, no temperature control). Disabled (left empty) by default.

preset_mode_fan_only_value.label: Fan only mode value
preset_mode_fan_only_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to FAN ONLY (circulate air only, no heating/cooling). Disabled (left empty) by default.

hvac_status_address.label: HVAC status address
hvac_status_address.description: Optional PLC address to read the actual HVAC status, matched against the value(s) configured below for each mode. If not set, status is inferred from temperature comparison.

hvac_status_off_values.label: Off status value(s)
hvac_status_off_values.description: PLC value(s) meaning OFF, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 0 or 0,10). Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

hvac_status_heating_values.label: Heating status value(s)
hvac_status_heating_values.description: PLC value(s) meaning HEATING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 1 or 2,3). Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

hvac_status_cooling_values.label: Cooling status value(s)
hvac_status_cooling_values.description: PLC value(s) meaning COOLING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 2 or 4,5). Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

hvac_status_idle_values.label: Idle status value(s)
hvac_status_idle_values.description: Optional PLC value(s) meaning IDLE (neither heating nor cooling), read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 9). Leave blank to treat any unmatched status as IDLE (default behavior).

hvac_status_drying_values.label: Drying status value(s)
hvac_status_drying_values.description: Optional PLC value(s) meaning DRYING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

hvac_status_fan_values.label: Fan status value(s)
hvac_status_fan_values.description: Optional PLC value(s) meaning FAN (circulating air only), read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

hvac_status_preheating_values.label: Preheating status value(s)
hvac_status_preheating_values.description: Optional PLC value(s) meaning PREHEATING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

hvac_status_defrosting_values.label: Defrosting status value(s)
hvac_status_defrosting_values.description: Optional PLC value(s) meaning DEFROSTING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

descriptions.heat_cool: Control separate heating and cooling outputs.

descriptions.plc: Read optional heating and cooling feedback bits from the PLC.

descriptions.on_off: Write the setpoint and a separate power bit.
descriptions.coded: Write numeric requested HVAC modes to the PLC.
descriptions.coded_on_off: Write coded HVAC modes and a separate power bit.

climate_action_feedback.label: Operating-status source
climate_action_feedback.description: Infer actual operation from current and target temperatures.

descriptions.inferred: Infer actual operation from current and target temperatures.
descriptions.plc: Read the actual heating, cooling, or idle action from a coded PLC value.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Configure measured temperature, limits, and setpoint.

direct_function.title: Direct-control function
direct_function.description: Choose which outputs Home Assistant controls.

direct_feedback.title: Direct action feedback
direct_feedback.description: Choose how actual heating and cooling activity is detected.

mode_control.title: HVAC mode commands
mode_control.description: Choose how Home Assistant sends setpoint, mode, and power commands.

available_modes.title: Available HVAC modes
available_modes.description: Empty values disable that mode. Values are written to the mode address when coded control is enabled, and always determine which modes Home Assistant exposes.

mode_feedback.title: HVAC mode feedback
mode_feedback.description: Choose whether the selected HVAC mode is remembered or read back from the PLC. This is separate from operating status.

action_feedback.title: Operating-status feedback
action_feedback.description: Choose how Home Assistant determines actual heating, cooling, idle, and other operating actions.

source_entity.label: Source entity
source_entity.description: Home Assistant entity whose value will be written to the PLC.

address.label: PLC address
address.description: PLC address to write the value (e.g., DB1,D0, DB2,W4).

invert_state.label: Invert state
invert_state.description: Invert binary states before writing them to a PLC BIT address.

control_behavior.label: Control behavior
control_behavior.sync_requires_different: Requires different state and command addresses.

direct.title: Direct control
direct.description: Home Assistant writes the command address and reads the state address. State and command remain independent.

sync.title: Synchronize command with state
sync.description: When the PLC state changes externally, the value read from the state address is also written to the command address. Useful when the PLC uses a command marker and a separate address or physical output as the real state.

pulse.title: Pulse control
pulse.description: Send a timed pulse to the command address instead of maintaining the ON/OFF value.

connection_details.title: Connection details
connection_details.description: Read-only connection parameters for this PLC.

availability.title: Connection availability
availability.timeline_label: PLC connection states over the last 24 hours
availability.history_unavailable: Historical data is not available; the current status is still shown above.

actions.delete_confirm: Delete this entity? This action cannot be undone.
